title: SKAB run valve2/0
note: Real data from the SKAB pump rig. The shaded band is the fault labelled by SKAB.

alerts.title: Vibration A sensor looks faulty: erratic signal (loose contact or interference)
reasons: The reading became erratic (2.4x normal variability, jumps 2.7x the largest healthy step).
The related vibration B signal stayed calm, which a real machine change would rarely allow.
alerts.cause: Instrument problem, not the machine: wiring, connector, power or calibration.
alerts.action: Check the vibration a transmitter and its wiring before sending mechanical maintenance. Treat its readings as unreliable until it is checked.
alerts.truth: Overlaps a fault labelled in SKAB.

alerts.title: Vibration A rose 3.7σ, confirmed by vibration B
reasons: The related vibration B signal moved too, so the change is physical.
alerts.cause: Mechanical change at the pump: imbalance, looseness or cavitation.
alerts.action: Inspect the pump mounting, coupling and impeller on pump P-101 this shift. Assembly and Packing depend on this station.
alerts.truth: No labelled fault here: this alarm counts as a false alarm in our metrics.
